title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode4 For the Stream

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_idol_op2
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...which is why I'm thinking about taking this light over to the MORE MORE HOUSE since I couldn't last time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I didn't realize you still had so much equipment left here.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm also a bit surprised. I mean, your streams until now were generally taken using a smartphone.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we were only doing streams, then all we would really need is one smartphone. These lights and such wouldn't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Plus, the rooftop got plenty of sun.
But we're going to need these kinds of lights if we're going to be streaming indoors.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I see.
You've really got all your bases covered, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for showing us your video editing program, as well as how to use a green screen. That was very educational.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I could help somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <In any case, it sounds like the MORE MORE HOUSE is nearly ready to open for business. It's wonderful to see you girls taking such a big step forward.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And it sounds like everyone has been talking about your last TV appearance. I'm very much looking forward to how things unfold in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...
Me too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Is something the matter?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so... A lot of new people have started tuning into our streams lately thanks to our recent TV appearance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And Airi mentioned how this is sort of a turning point for us as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why we need to think carefully about how to proceed moving forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <How to proceed?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
As things currently stand, we're able to pick and choose which offers for work we want to accept.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if we're serious about eventually doing a show at the Dome, then we may need to come up with a detailed plan as to how we're going to do that. Like what shows to appear on at what time and such...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <A detailed plan...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We need to think about how we're going to expand our fan base and to what size. Also, what kinds of events we're going to put on to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like these sorts of long-term goals are important to think about.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Now I see...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Me too. It is going to be crucial for you all to create some checkpoints for yourself.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<You never cease to amaze me, Haruka.
Despite being so busy, you've found the time to think about your group's future.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I haven't actually given it that much thought.
I'm guessing this is the result of my old producer's habits rubbing off onto me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Your old producer?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, when I was still in ASRUN.
He always made sure to let the idols he was working with know about what he was thinking.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: About the commemorative show that's coming up. You'll be performing at a live house other than SPRAY.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we've done most of our commemorative shows at SPRAY...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ASRUN's been performing there since we debuted. It's sort of like our home turf at this point...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Won't a sudden change of venue cause some confusion among our fans? We'll sort of be asking them to play an away game instead...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: That's exactly why we're making this switch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: Yes, SPRAY has somewhat become ASRUN's home, and we have a good number of regulars coming each time.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: However, I'm afraid that ASRUN won't make it big as long as it's billed as “idols who perform for idol fans”.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: I believe ASRUN needs to start connecting with more people and expanding its fan base. It can't remain a group for die-hard fans.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: The song we just released the other day has become a huge hit, so this is ASRUN's chance to turn this commemorative show into something really special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what about the fans who've been faithfully following us until now? Won't we disappoint them...?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: I know. We shouldn't do anything to dash our fans' hopes. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Producer
rows.Line: I plan on inviting those who've been members of this group's fan club the longest, and offering them free passes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...is an example of how he explained one of his long-term goals along with his thought process to me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And my old producer was right.
Our fan base came to encompass people from all walks of life, so I naturally became drawn to his way of thinking.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I had no idea...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <This producer for ASRUN must've been quite an incredible person. I can see why your group was placed in his charge.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had a lot of respect for him because he was so reliable.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we don't have anyone like that right now. We've managed so far, but that's something we may need to think about in the future...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Now your path forward sounds much more difficult...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's why we need to start thinking about these things now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I didn't realize it was this late.
I need to head over to the electronics store.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's right...
You need to go buy some more equipment for your streams.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. This seems like a nice opportunity to replace our old ones.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, we should probably head back.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Right.
Please let us know what happens later.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I will. Thank you for stopping by.
I'll let you know if I need any help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Please do!
See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel kind of bad about dominating the conversation like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'll go over to let them know once I've hammered out my ideas. So, for now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <H-Haruka. Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You just left a second ago...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Th-Th-The thing is...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<We have an emergency in SEKAI!
You need to come over right now!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?
